analysis.summary: An early draft built around Maxey, VJ and LeBron, since Brown's hamstring and Embiid's illness are both open questions. Indiana is 6-12 without Haliburton and gives up 115.7 points a game, which helps the counting stats. The main risk is a big Sixers lead that sits the starters in the fourth quarter.

slips.Props only: Nine props: Maxey and VJ pts + reb + ast and threes, VJ and LeBron steals, LeBron pts + reb + ast and rebounds, and Simons 1+ three.
slips.With -2.5: The same eight core props plus the Sixers -2.5 in place of Simons' three.

watch.title: Starters may sit late
watch.text: Indiana has lost four of its last five and the Sixers have won six straight meetings. A big lead cuts fourth-quarter minutes for the pts + reb + ast legs.

watch.title: A soft defense
watch.text: Indiana allows 115.7 points a game (21st) and is without Haliburton, Sheppard and Furphy.

watch.title: Back-to-back next
watch.text: The Sixers play at Houston Saturday, so tonight's minutes should be normal, but watch for any rest news on LeBron.
